evals.prompt: Set up Pester tests for the PowerShell scripts in scripts/wordpress-scripts/.
evals.expected_output: Checks that Pester 6.x is installed (gives the Install-Module command if not, without installing it), creates scripts/wordpress-scripts/tests/, copies BrunoFake.ps1 from the assets (or reports a difference if one exists), adds a first test file for get-published-posts.ps1 from Script.Tests.ps1, runs run-tests.ps1 from the repo root and reports the gate result and the Pester summary.
assertions: Checks the installed Pester version live
Copies BrunoFake.ps1 into scripts/wordpress-scripts/tests/ without overwriting an existing one
Runs scripts/run-tests.ps1 and reports Gate: OK and the pass/fail counts
Makes no network call to aidevme.com

evals.expected_output: Reads the script (paging with --env-var page=N, the fields it keeps, every throw), starts from Script.Tests.ps1, replaces the one-page test with per-page answers from Use-FakeBruno, adds tests for duplicates and the X-WP-Total check, HTTP errors, a missing report, masked values, the AIDEVME_WP_* restore and scratch-folder cleanup, writes output to $TestDrive, and runs the tests.
assertions: Uses Use-FakeBruno and never Mock npx

evals.prompt: My Pester test for sync-post-folders fails with 'call depth overflow' on Test-Path.
evals.expected_output: Explains that the default Test-Path mock calls the module-qualified cmdlet, which recurses into the mock, and replaces it with a CommandInfo captured by Get-Command Test-Path -CommandType Cmdlet, keeping the filtered mock for the admin .env.
assertions: Identifies the module-qualified call in the default mock as the cause
Uses Get-Command Test-Path -CommandType Cmdlet in the default mock
Never reads or creates the real .env file

evals.prompt: Why does Mock npx not work in my test? The script still calls the live site.
evals.expected_output: Explains that npx resolves to npm's npx.ps1 (ExternalScript), which Pester's Mock doesn't replace, that the test therefore reached aidevme.com, and switches the test to BrunoFake.ps1 (Block-LiveNpx, Use-FakeBruno, Remove-BrunoFake); notes the run-tests.ps1 gate rejects Mock npx.
assertions: Names npx.ps1 / ExternalScript as the cause
Says the earlier run reached the live site

evals.prompt: Run the PowerShell tests with coverage.
evals.expected_output: Runs pwsh -File .claude/skills/aidevme-powershell-test/scripts/run-tests.ps1 -Coverage from the repo root and reports the gate, passed/failed/skipped counts, the coverage percentage and the report paths under temp/pester/.
assertions: Runs run-tests.ps1 with -Coverage from the repo root
Reports the coverage percentage and temp/pester/coverage.xml

evals.prompt: Refactor the scripts so the Bruno calls can be mocked properly.
evals.expected_output: Proposes moving the shared scaffolding into a module such as scripts/wordpress-scripts/AidevmeBruno.psm1 with Invoke-BrunoRequest, for one script first, with the tests that will prove it behaves the same; waits for approval before changing any script.
assertions: Writes or runs tests against the current script before the change

evals.prompt: Add a Bruno test that checks the tags endpoint returns x-wp-total.
evals.expected_output: Not this skill: Bruno request tests belong to aidevme-bruno.
